literal_gloss: I-read the Acts of-the Seventh Council, in sessions [lacuna], in which both the heresy of-the iconoclasts was-led-in-triumph and the faith of-the orthodox shone-forth.
lemmas: ΠΡΑΚΤΙΚΑ ΤΗΣ ΕΒΔΟΜΗΣ ΣΥΝΟΔΟΥ (Acts of the Seventh Council)
ἐθριαμβεύθη (was led in triumph / put to open defeat)
διέλαμψεν ἡ πίστις (the faith shone forth)
source_text: Codex 20 Greek from photius_bibliotheca_greek_lock.txt (Bekker 1824, p. 5; 2026-09-18 image n16)
